item.title: Why has Qatar dedicated 2026 to celebrating Mexico?
item.description: Qatar is set to celebrate the best of Mexican food and culture this year, but why is the Middle Eastern nation so interested in a country on the other side of the world? The post Why has Qatar dedicated 2026 to celebrating Mexico? appeared first on Mexico News Daily

item.title: Mothers of Sinaloa’s missing protest during Mazatlán Carnival
item.description: Taking advantage of the visibility enjoyed by what is considered one of the best carnivals in Mexico, more than 100 women marched in silence, displaying banners with the names of their missing loved ones to the thousands of people who had gathered to see the parade floats. item.title: Mexico, Canada announce joint economic action plan for a post-USMCA future
item.description: "Robotics, drones, artificial intelligence, vaccines, new technologies and medicine, everything can be done," said Economy Minister Marcelo Ebrard, who described Canada as a "very reliable partner for Mexico." item.title: This year, Mexico City has had only 3 days of acceptable air quality
item.description: A warmer winter than usual, combined with the dry climate this time of year, created ideal conditions for the accumulation of ozone in the Mexico City metropolitan area, leading the city to declare an environmental alert for a third straight day. The post This year, Mexico City has had only 3 days of acceptable air quality appeared first on Mexico News Daily

item.title: Navy warns of record sargassum season ahead of Easter holiday
item.description: According to a crowd-sourced sargassum map, beachgoers located between Puerto Aventuras and Tulum are already reporting the presence of the seaweed. The post Navy warns of record sargassum season ahead of Easter holiday appeared first on Mexico News Daily

item.title: Mexico City and México state to hold earthquake drill Wednesday
item.description: The first of three drills this year will be limited to Mexico City and its adjoining state, giving authorities a chance to practice rescue work and residents a chance to rehearse evacuations. item.title: Transition Industries set to break ground on US $3.3B methanol plant in Sinaloa
item.description: When the methanol plant begins operations in 2029-2030, it is expected to be the largest ultra-low carbon chemicals facility in the world, according to Transition Industries. item.title: US $115M Sonora project joins growing catalog of made-in-Mexico EVs
item.description: Adding to the federal government's “Olinia” and Tlaxcala's “Totally Tlaxcalan,” the private-sector initiative Beyond Movilidad Compartida (Beyond Shared Mobility) is developing an EV that can be used for passenger transport and last-mile deliveries. item.title: Scientists identify new snake species endemic to Mexico
item.description: Mexico is the world leader in snake species with over 400 known varieties, and now it has one more: a small and unusual underground dweller of which only one live specimen has been observed. The post Scientists identify new snake species endemic to Mexico appeared first on Mexico News Daily

item.title: Mexico declines Trump’s invitation to join Board of Peace: Tuesday’s mañanera recapped
item.description: President Sheinbaum explained on Tuesday that Mexico's refusal stemmed from Palestine's absence at the inaugural session of the board — despite its stated mandate to oversee the reconstruction of Gaza — and noted that Mexico recognizes Palestine as a sovereign state.
